title: Eight stations, revisited as evidence changes

elements.alt: Capability Productization Cycle route: strategy; consumer and producer requirements; architecture; solution and interaction design; delivery and operations; readiness; publishing and enablement; monitoring and improvement; feedback returns to earlier decisions

elements.text: Use the stations to expose missing decisions and evidence. Return to earlier work when assumptions change.

notes:
The eight labels and their order follow the Capability Productization Cycle station mapping in method-data. This simplified route is an original presentation diagram, not the API Productization metro map. It does not prescribe a one-way delivery process.

The supplier-payment status capability is a newly authored fictional teaching example, not a client implementation or measured outcome. Figures, service promises and release criteria are illustrative proposals requiring validation. Working summaries are not reproductions of canonical canvas templates.
